messages:
Anya: quick sync — we need a lightweight partner SEV playbook for marketplace + SI partners, less war-room heavy, more "micro-warroom" + signal fallback. suggestions?
Sam: +1. fewer pages to scroll during nights. what are the must-haves?
Ravi: must-haves: single shared channel, an oncall rota, an agreed escalation tree, and a canonical link to the partner RCA template.
Priya: also a fallback path if the partner Slack goes down (phone list + pager fallback). call-tree-lite should be documented.
Devon: for marketplace partners we must include marketplace ops contact and listing owner — they can flip the listing to maintenance mode if needed.
Anya: ok: propose structure: 1) trigger conditions, 2) who to page, 3) micro-warroom checklist, 4) fallback steps, 5) postmortem owner.
Sam: trigger conditions examples?
Ravi: e.g., customer 5xx rate > 3x baseline for 5min, onboarding flow broken for > 30 users, or a data leak suspicion. keep thresholds high to avoid noise.
Priya: micro-warroom checklist (brief): pin partner-bridge, pin playbook URL, snapshot of logs, rule out infra vs model, decide if we escalate to full SEV. 3 bullets max.
Devon: fallback steps: 1) open shared incident ticket, 2) escalate to partner SOC via email/phone, 3) open cloud provider support case (if infra suspected), 4) create temp token rotation if creds suspect.
Anya: good. what about shared channel naming and perms?
Sam: naming: #partner-<org>-sev-<yyyymmdd> for ad-hoc. For persistent liaison channels: #partner-<org>-liaison. perms: partner members + Redwood oncall + product PM.
Ravi: add a simple bridge command snippet for ops-bot to create the channel and pin 3 things: playbook url, runbook digest, and contact sheet.
Priya: ops-bot sample:
```
/ops create-partner-bridge --org acme --template micro-warroom
/pin https://redwood.internal/playbooks/partner-micro-warroom
/pin https://redwood.internal/contacts/acme
```
Devon: can ops-bot also post the oncall rota automatically? will reduce manual errors.
Sam: yes, ops-bot should pull oncall from PagerDuty rota tag partner_acme and post current oncall + phone.
Anya: decision: adopt this micro-playbook for all marketplace + SI partners initially, run a dry-run with 2 partners next week. who volunteers to draft the repo?
Ravi: I can draft. will include examples and the ops-bot snippets.
Priya: I'll coordinate the dry-run schedule and notify oncall.
Devon: I'll notify marketplace partners and prepare the listing maintenance toggle doc.
Sam: I'll add runbook quick-checks for support triage (logs + token validity + API quota).
Anya: great. timeline: draft by Tue EOD, dry-run Thurs 10am PT.
Ravi: noted. drafting now.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: dry-run with acme and theta partners on 1745011200 -> join #partner-dryrun. :bell:
Anya: thanks team. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
